motion.purpose: Initial stationary fraction before the quintic eased scene transition.

motion.name: camera-spring
motion.purpose: Smooth native-scroll response for the shared stage.

motion.name: chapter-reveal
motion.value: iris, curtain, arch, curtain, iris, arch
motion.purpose: Deterministic six-boundary sequence over opaque base and clipped overlay; pose depends only on position, so upward and downward travel match. Endpoint snap tolerance is 0.00001.

motion.name: iris-pose
motion.purpose: Centered reveal; outgoing base scale grows from 1 to 1.025 during all transition kinds.

motion.name: curtain-pose
motion.purpose: Side-curtain reveal with restrained horizontal translation.

motion.name: arch-pose
motion.purpose: Rounded rising arch, not a full vertical scene slide.

motion.name: greeting-letters
motion.purpose: One staged entrance when the greeting becomes active.

motion.name: greeting-repel
motion.purpose: Local fine-pointer glyph interaction; returns on pointer leave and is disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: typed-interests
motion.purpose: Software / AI / Cloud types once per greeting entry; full text is exposed to assistive technology.

motion.name: fabric-drift
motion.value: 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate; 6 fibres, 3 on phones and in projects
motion.purpose: Active atmospheric scenes only; pauses when hidden or manually paused, and is absent under reduced motion.

motion.name: canvas-float
motion.purpose: Inner folded-CFS composition only while its chapter is active; the rearrange action stays still. Hidden, manual-pause, and reduced-motion safeguards apply.

motion.name: canvas-rearrange
motion.purpose: Reversible leaf transforms after an explicit pressed-state toggle; no transition under reduced motion.

motion.name: relief-drift
motion.purpose: One shallow relief on active atmospheric chapters; hidden/manual pause stops it and reduced motion disables it.

motion.name: contour-drift
motion.purpose: Active project contour linework only; hidden/manual pause stops it and reduced motion disables it.

motion.name: experience-entry
motion.purpose: Finite raised-card entrance on the experience chapter.

narrative.northStar: A personal workshop on woven canvas
narrative.overview:
The portfolio feels personal, elegant, and a little playful. Muted fabric-like grounds, an original folded CFS canvas composition, and large Bodoni lettering give it an identity connected to its owner. Professional information stays readable in Manrope, with friendly Indonesian copy rather than advertising slogans.

Texture is a clearly woven, static material; motion supplies the changing point of view. Fullscreen chapters provide room to read before reversible iris, side-curtain, and rounded-arch reveals, while controls and selected information panels feel raised or pressed into their surroundings. Sparse vector linework, drifting fibres, and shallow relief move slowly without covering the work. The folded canvas is code-native geometry, not a rendered person or mascot.
keyCharacteristics: Woven canvas and muted chapter colors.
Expressive serif display type with clear sans-serif information.
Tactile controls and selectively moulded information panels.
Folded CFS canvas leaves with a stable rearrange control.
Fullscreen exploration with accessible content fallbacks.

rules.name: The Chapter Pair Rule
rules.body: A ground travels with its ink and control tones from `src/data/journey.ts`. Do not place a chapter's foreground on a different ground without checking contrast.

rules.name: The One Expressive Voice Rule
rules.body: Reserve the large serif gesture for names and chapter titles; let factual content remain quiet and legible.

rules.name: The Quiet Material Rule
rules.body: Canvas is a static repeated SVG tile. Keep the weave clearly visible but subordinate to the type and work, with unfilled pattern paths preserving legibility. Atmospheric fibres, relief, and selected contours are separate, slow CSS layers with an explicit pause control.

dos: Do keep the woven texture static and clearly visible without competing with text.
Do carry a chapter's ground, ink, and control tones together.
Do use tactile depth on controls and selectively moulded profile and experience panels.
Do keep screenshots uncropped and show technology logos with accessible names.
Do preserve keyboard access, visible focus, reduced motion, and readable mobile content.
Do write friendly, specific Indonesian grounded in Caesar's actual work.
donts: Don't add moving noise, full-screen blur, or a canvas runtime for texture; keep atmosphere sparse and pausable.
Don't animate every object or expand pointer tracking into the whole composition.
Don't turn factual sections into stacks of decorative containers.
Don't add generic uppercase eyebrows, exaggerated tracking, invented metrics, or promotional filler.
Don't imply that a project without a deployment has a working live demo.
